page.layout: Running head at top left with page number; one column of running text, with a fragment carried over from the previous page at the top. Below the text, centred: "AMEN." Then a division heading "CONCIO XXXI.", followed by the verse reference "Tob. 10." Then the text of the new sermon in one column, opening with a large woodcut initial.

main_text.p: esse, gloriam Dei hoc pacto spargendam in gentes multas, pro qua praedicanda idoneos se possent praedicatores praestare, experti bonitatem Dei in beneficiis & praemonitionibus prophetarum, nunc vero iustitiam in contemptores legum suarum, &c. Talem charitatem tum erga Deum, tum erga proximum, largiatur nobis omnibus & singulis Dominus noster & seruator Iesus Christus.
main_text.head: CONCIO XXXI.
Tob. 10.

p.i: T vero Raguel dicebat ad generum suum: Mane hic, & ego mittam nuncium salutis de te ad Tobiam patrem tuum.

Cui Tobias ait: Ego noui, quia pater me-us & mater mea modo dies computant, et cruciatur spiritus eorum in ipsis. Cum que verbis multis rogaret Raguel Tobi-am, & ille eum nulla ratione vellet audi-re, tradidit ei Saram, & dimidiam partem omnis substantiae suae, in pueris, in puellis, in pecudibus, in camelis, & in vaccis, & pecunia multa, & saluum atq; gaudentem dimisit eum a se, dicens: Angelus Domini sanctus sit in itinere vestro, perducatq;

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorative letter of an ornamental A-shape; the word it opens is printed as "T vero" after it, so the woodcut letter is not read as text. Text is complete on the page; the last word is cut off at the column foot as printed ("perducatq;"). Long s is plain s throughout. No marginal notes are printed on this page. No catchword or signature. The bottom of the page carries a small bullet mark, not text.
